recentItems.title: Shehnaaz Gill Recalls Being Body-Shamed And Trolled For Her Language On Bigg Boss
recentItems.description:
Shehnaaz Gill has never been one to hold back when it comes to expressing her thoughts, and this time, she is opening up about body-shaming, trolling and society’s obsession with how women should look. In a recent conversation, Shehnaaz recalled the intense trolling she faced during her Bigg Boss 13 journey. The actress said she was criticised not just for her body, but also for the way she spoke and conducted herself on the show.
